$comment: G1 completion record — machine-readable inventory of every actions/upload-artifact site in .github/workflows/. Companion narrative: artifact_upload_inventory_2026-10-10.md. All path:line citations resolve to the post-PR-#710 workflow YAML (measured_base.post_pr710_tree) unless a citation says otherwise. produced by the storage-retention bookkeeping slice.
filename_date_note: filename carries 2026-10-10 per the task contract (storage-retention workstream date); measurements taken 2026-10-11

measured_base.pr710_state_at_authoring: OPEN, unmerged (gh pr view 710 --json state -> OPEN, 2026-10-11)
measured_base.tree_deltas: admission-check.yml and runner-pool-acceptance.yml are the only workflow files that differ between the two trees; on origin/main, admission-check.yml additionally has a 7th upload site (J3 test-mode nimcache re-upload into the base B-carrier, commits e0553280b/af3cfa2e7) and lacks the 4 retention-days:3 values and the AXIOM_ARTIFACT_RECORD steps

method.requested_retention_days: read from each upload step's `retention-days:` on the post-PR-#710 YAML; origin/main value recorded separately (null + note = implicit 90-day default)
method.expected_retention_days: the repo/org global default that github.retention_days resolves to — days: 90 (docs/evidence/epoch_record_storage_retention_2026-10-10.md §4, AXIOM_ARTIFACT_RECORD v1 expected_retention_days at §3.2)
method.observed_retention_days: live REST census: (expires_at - created_at) per artifact, grouped by name pattern; expired artifacts are hidden by the API post-expiry, so an empty histogram means 'no live sample' -> unknown (not zero)
method.expiry_failure_mode: aggregate over consumers: the strictest binding consumer's behavior when the artifact is absent/expired at consumption time; per-consumer detail under consumers[]

divergence_from_task_census.explanation: the task census predates the venue-split evidence surface: admission-check.yml has 6 upload sites on both measured trees (sites 3-6 here: evidence-record, judgment-record, admission-verdict, witness), and observation.yml (site 22) carries a 22nd upload. The instruction to read the actual YAML governs; nothing was dropped to match the pre-measured count.
